101.description: Flag quartered yellow and blue: top hoist yellow, top fly blue, bottom hoist blue, bottom fly yellow.
101.interpretation: Booklet answer key (pages 10-16): Flag L - 'You should stop your vessel immediately'. Note: Black quarters are drawn blue in the booklet.

102.interpretation: Booklet answer key (pages 10-16): Flag D - 'Keep clear of me; I am manoeuvring with difficulty'.

103.description: Yellow flag with a blue circle (disc) in the centre.
103.interpretation: Booklet answer key (pages 10-16): Flag I - 'I am altering my course to port'. Note: Black disc is drawn blue in the booklet.

104.description: Flag divided diagonally: yellow triangle at the lower hoist, red triangle at the upper fly.
104.interpretation: Booklet answer key (pages 10-16): Flag O - 'Man overboard'.

105.interpretation: Booklet answer key (pages 10-16): Flag E - 'I am altering my course to starboard'.

106.interpretation: Booklet answer key (pages 10-16): Flag Q - 'My vessel is healthy and I request free pratique'.

107.description: White flag with a blue upright cross.
107.interpretation: Booklet answer key (pages 10-16): Flag X - 'Stop carrying out your intentions and watch for my signals'.

108.description: Blue flag with a white rectangle in the centre.
108.interpretation: Booklet answer key (pages 10-16): Flag P - all persons to return on board; on a fishing vessel - 'my nets are caught on an obstruction'.

109.description: White flag with a red diamond (lozenge) filling the middle.
109.interpretation: Booklet answer key (pages 10-16): Flag F - 'I am disabled; communicate with me'.

110.description: White flag with a red diagonal cross (saltire).
110.interpretation: Booklet answer key (pages 10-16): Flag V - 'I require assistance' (booklet stresses: NOT distress).

111.description: One dot. Legend on page: read left to right; dot = short blast, short bar = long blast, very long bar = prolonged ('ממושך').
111.interpretation: Booklet answer key (pages 10-16): 'I am altering my course to starboard.'

112.description: One bar (one long/prolonged blast). Legend on page: read left to right; dot = short blast, short bar = long blast, very long bar = prolonged ('ממושך').
112.interpretation: Booklet answer key (pages 10-16): Power-driven vessel making way in restricted visibility.

113.description: Three dots (three short blasts). Legend on page: read left to right; dot = short blast, short bar = long blast, very long bar = prolonged ('ממושך').
113.interpretation: Booklet answer key (pages 10-16): Power-driven vessel operating astern propulsion.

114.description: Two dots (two short blasts). Legend on page: read left to right; dot = short blast, short bar = long blast, very long bar = prolonged ('ממושך').
114.interpretation: Booklet answer key (pages 10-16): 'I am altering my course to port.'

115.description: Five dots (five short blasts). Legend on page: read left to right; dot = short blast, short bar = long blast, very long bar = prolonged ('ממושך').
115.interpretation: Booklet answer key (pages 10-16): 'I do not understand your intentions/manoeuvre' (doubt / warning signal).

116.description: Bar, bar, dot, dot (two long then two short). Legend on page: read left to right; dot = short blast, short bar = long blast, very long bar = prolonged ('ממושך').
116.interpretation: Booklet answer key (pages 10-16): 'I intend to overtake you on your port (left) side.'

117.description: Bar, dot, bar, dot (long, short, long, short). Legend on page: read left to right; dot = short blast, short bar = long blast, very long bar = prolonged ('ממושך').
117.interpretation: Booklet answer key (pages 10-16): 'I agree to be overtaken.'

118.description: Bar, bar (two long blasts, with a gap). Legend on page: read left to right; dot = short blast, short bar = long blast, very long bar = prolonged ('ממושך').
118.interpretation: Booklet answer key (pages 10-16): Power-driven vessel under way in restricted visibility, stopped and not making way.

119.description: One very long continuous bar (continuous sounding). Legend on page: read left to right; dot = short blast, short bar = long blast, very long bar = prolonged ('ממושך').
119.interpretation: Booklet answer key (pages 10-16): 'I am in distress and require immediate help!' (continuous sounding).

120.description: Bar, dot, dot, dot (one long, three short). Legend on page: read left to right; dot = short blast, short bar = long blast, very long bar = prolonged ('ממושך').
120.interpretation: Booklet answer key (pages 10-16): 'I am loading/carrying/discharging dangerous cargo' / vessel being towed (restricted visibility). Note: 1 long + 3 short is the COLREG restricted-visibility signal for the (manned) towed vessel; the dangerous-cargo meaning is the booklet's own addition.

121.description: Bar, bar, dot (two long, one short). Legend on page: read left to right; dot = short blast, short bar = long blast, very long bar = prolonged ('ממושך').
121.interpretation: Booklet answer key (pages 10-16): 'I intend to overtake you on your starboard (right) side.'

122.description: Bar, dot, dot (one long, two short). Legend on page: read left to right; dot = short blast, short bar = long blast, very long bar = prolonged ('ממושך').
122.interpretation: Booklet answer key (pages 10-16): Restricted visibility: vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre / constrained by her draught / not under command / sailing vessel / towing, making way.

123.description: Bar, dot, bar (long, short, long). Legend on page: read left to right; dot = short blast, short bar = long blast, very long bar = prolonged ('ממושך').
123.interpretation: Booklet answer key (pages 10-16): Distractor - not a valid signal (booklet answer for 123-126: 'מסיחים').

124.description: Bar, bar, bar (three long; slightly larger gap before the third). Legend on page: read left to right; dot = short blast, short bar = long blast, very long bar = prolonged ('ממושך').
124.interpretation: Booklet answer key (pages 10-16): Distractor - not a valid signal.

125.description: Dot, bar, bar (short, long, long). Legend on page: read left to right; dot = short blast, short bar = long blast, very long bar = prolonged ('ממושך').
125.interpretation: Booklet answer key (pages 10-16): Distractor - not a valid signal.

126.description: Dot, bar (short, long). Legend on page: read left to right; dot = short blast, short bar = long blast, very long bar = prolonged ('ממושך').
126.interpretation: Booklet answer key (pages 10-16): Distractor - not a valid signal.

127.description: Title 'מצבי שייט' (encounter situations). Compass-rose diagram: 16 boat silhouettes arranged around a centre point, each pointing toward the centre, labelled A to P clockwise. A at top (blue boat, pointing down toward centre), B, C (green), D (orange), E at right (magenta/pink boat with red outline, pointing left), F, G (green), H, I at bottom (magenta boat, pointing up), J, K (green), L, M at left (blue boat, pointing right), N (orange), O (green), P. Boat colours: A and M blue; E and I magenta; C, G, K, O green; D, F, L, N orange; B, H, J, P grey. Dotted lines join opposite positions through the centre. Some letter boxes are coloured (A, M blue; C, K, O green; D orange; E, I red letters).
127.interpretation: Booklet answer key (pages 10-16): Relative positions (encounter situations) between vessels.
